title: Radial Tail Repair: Post-Training Correction for Diffusion and Flow Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching models may struggle to accurately represent distributional tails, especially for heavy-tailed data. Existing approaches often use heavy-tailed noise or modify the generative dynamics, requiring dedicated retraining and more difficult estimation. We take a simpler approach: rather than relearning the full distribution, we correct only the model's behavior in the extreme regime. Our method builds on the radial-angular decomposition of multivariate heavy tails, where radius and direction become asymptotically independent. This allows us to preserve the directional structure learned by the pretrained model and correct only its radial tail. We estimate the tail onset from reference and generated samples, then rescale generated extremes so that their radial survival matches the target distribution. The resulting method is a lightweight post-training correction applied to a frozen diffusion or flow-matching model,

translated_title: 径向尾部修复：针对扩散模型与流模型的后训练校正
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流匹配模型可能难以准确表示分布的尾部，尤其是对于重尾数据。现有方法通常使用重尾噪声或修改生成动力学，需要专门的重新训练和更困难的估计。我们采取一种更简单的方法：不是重新学习整个分布，而是仅校正模型在极端区域的行为。我们的方法建立在多元重尾分布的径向-角度分解之上，其中半径和方向渐近独立。这使我们能够保留预训练模型学到的方向结构，仅校正其径向尾部。我们从参考样本和生成样本中估计尾部起始点，然后重新缩放生成的极端值，使其径向生存分布与目标分布相匹配。所得方法是一种轻量级的后训练校正，可应用于冻结的扩散或流匹配模型。
tldr: 提出一种轻量级后训练校正方法，基于多元重尾的径向-角度分解，在保持冻结的扩散或流匹配模型方向结构不变的情况下，仅通过重缩放生成样本的径向尾部来修正模型对重尾分布极端区域的表示。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight post-training correction that leverages the radial-angular decomposition of multivariate heavy tails to fix the radial tail behavior of frozen diffusion or flow-matching models, preserving their learned directional structure while only rescaling generated extremes.
